data.title: 泽塔 · 屋顶任务后的乘凉
data.description: 盛夏任务归来，泽塔蹲在据点屋顶的阴影里，把史莱姆战服褪到腰间乘凉。金色的猫耳懒洋洋地垂着，长尾绕住脚踝——只有确认四下无人时，金豹才肯露出这样毫无防备的样子。
data.location: 阴影庭园据点屋顶·夏夜
data.action: 蹲在屋顶阴影里，战服半褪至腰间，猫耳垂落，尾巴绕住脚踝
data.lighting: summer night moonlight and distant town lights
data.promptProse: Back from a summer mission, adult Zeta crouches in the rooftop shade with her slime bodysuit slipped down to her waist, golden cat ears drooping in the heat.
data.animaCaption: Only the moon sees Zeta like this — guard down, ears down, cooling off above the sleeping town.
